about: Soil HIL A values used by the tidy checks (LOR against criterion, marginal results near a blank). Copied from the verified criteria set compiled 2026-09-23 (criteria-verified.md, Table A). Values are strings so they load as exact decimals.
used_for: Used only in the tidy step: to check that detection limits are low enough to compare with these values, and to mark a soil result linked to a blank as marginal. No tool screens detected soil results against them.

criteria.label: sum of PFOS and PFHxS
criteria.document: PFAS National Environmental Management Plan Version 3.1 (HEPA 2026)
criteria.note: Applies to PFOS only, PFHxS only, and the sum of the two (Table 5, footnote a). The HIL A value is the same in NEMP 3.0 and 3.1.

criteria.label: PFOA
criteria.document: PFAS National Environmental Management Plan Version 3.1 (HEPA 2026)
criteria.note: The HIL A value is the same in NEMP 3.0 and 3.1.

criteria.label: Arsenic
criteria.document: ASC NEPM 1999 Schedule B1 (compilation F2013C00288, 16 May 2013)
criteria.note: Arsenic (as the table row reads); the value assumes 70% oral bioavailability (Table 1A(1), note 2).

criteria.document: ASC NEPM 1999 Schedule B1 (compilation F2013C00288, 16 May 2013)
criteria.note: The value is for chromium (VI). Comparing total chromium with it is a conservative screen.
